shortDescription: Corsair Vengeance DDR5 32GB (2 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Kit (Solid Black Aluminum Heatspreader / Dual Profile Intel XMP 3.0 & AMD EXPO Compatible / 1.35V / CMK32GX5M2B6000C38 / 1-Year Local Warranty)
descriptionHtml:
Corsair Vengeance DDR5 32GB (2 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Kit (Solid Black Aluminum Heatspreader / Dual Profile Intel XMP 3.0 & AMD EXPO Compatible / 1.35V / CMK32GX5M2B6000C38 / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Optimize your PC gaming rig and professional workspace with the Corsair Vengeance DDR5 32GB (2x16GB) 6000MHz Memory Kit in classic matte black finish, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Crafted for extreme speed and rock-solid system stability, this dual-channel DDR5 kit reaches high frequencies up to 6000MHz with tight CL38 timings at 1.35V. Designed with dual platform flexibility, it integrates pre-configured profiles for both Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO, making BIOS setup and one-click performance tuning seamless across modern Intel and AMD motherboards. Built with low-profile anodized aluminum heatspreaders in solid black, it guarantees top-tier thermal dissipation while ensuring high clearance compatibility with large CPU air coolers and tight chassis builds.
